profile.headline: Applied AI @ Databricks

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Genie Code, LLM Strategy & Production
- Own LLM selection for Genie Code, Databricks' AI agent for data and code, from evaluating candidates to deciding which models ship
- Built the launch framework (offline evaluation, A/B testing, staged rollouts, rollback) for taking frontier and open-weight models to production

Tech Lead, Coding Assistance
- Domain-specific fine-tuning to adapt LLMs for developer productivity
- Metric-driven end-to-end optimization to improve reliability and adoption of AI-assisted coding

Founding member of the Applied AI Team
- Team behind the creation of Databricks Dolly
- Early work on adapting LLMs to Databricks product applications
- AI-driven infrastructure optimization for Databricks serverless products

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (ML), Tech Lead Manager
positions.description: TLM of Marketplace Matching Inference: Team optimizes the rider/driver matching decision through Machine Learning, Algorithm Solving, and Scalable Backend Design.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer in Machine Learning
positions.description:
Mattermark is using machine learning and big data techniques to collect, organize and analyze world's business information.

# Applied NLP to extract start-up funding data from raw news articles on the web. Used techniques include deep neural word embedding (Word2Vec) and classification model.
# Implemented feature extraction service that converts company information to input vector for ML pipelines.
# Built automated ML system to tag the industries of 4 million+ companies in Mattermark's database.
# Created general-purpose ML pipeline that trains company classification model and generates prediction automatically.

positions.title: Translator
positions.description: Translated the book Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning(by Christopher Bishop) to Korean

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Data Scientist
positions.description:
As a member of growth relevance team, I worked on key big data and machine learning projects below.

# People You May Know: Solved link prediction problem on social graph. Optimized predictive classification algorithm by adding new features, re-training, validation and A/B testing. Improved the scalability of Hadoop workflow. Applied multi-objective optimization.

# Suggested Endorsements: Launched recommender system for skills endorsement. Created machine learning model and Hadoop workflow. Used techniques include supervised learning, multi-objective optimization and feature engineering.

#History Service: Enhanced the scalability of OLAP framework.

#Skill based personalized news recommendation

projects.title: Skill & Expertise Endorsements
projects.description: Interface design incorporating social proof and a light weight endorsement action to Profile Skills. This feature leveraged earlier work on Profile Guided Editing, and used the same guided UI to suggest skill endorsements to profile viewers. Recipients of the endorsement receive an email and on-site notification, with a landing experience that suggests they endorse people they know - creating a feel-good viral loop.

projects.title: Apache DataFu
projects.description: Apache DataFu is a collection of libraries for working with large-scale data in Hadoop. The project was inspired by the need for stable, well-tested libraries for data mining and statistics.
